name: ssf-skill-extractor
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. A CosineSimilarityLoss fine-tune of sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 on Singapore's SkillsFuture skill taxonomy, same 6-layer BERT / 384-d encoder, 22.7M. Card prints baseline and v1/v2 in one table: AUC 0.995 vs 0.978, best accuracy 0.971 vs 0.928, accuracy at the default 0.5 cosine threshold 0.968 vs 0.810 - the threshold row is the operationally interesting one. Domain-specific: 2,196 SSF skills, synthetic JD sentences from Qwen3-1.7B, held-out 10% split of the author's own pairs, not a public benchmark. Licence Apache-2.0, repo created 2026-02-23.

benchmarks.name: SSF held-out skill matching AUC
benchmarks.config: Card table '| Model | AUC | Acc @ 0.5 | Best Accuracy |': 'all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (baseline)' 0.978 vs 'SSF-MiniLM v2 (5 epochs)' 0.995 (x100). Held-out 10% split of the author's 21,958 synthetic (sentence, skill, label) pairs, 2,195 eval pairs, normalize_embeddings=True.

benchmarks.name: SSF held-out skill matching best accuracy
benchmarks.config: Same table, Best Accuracy 0.928 baseline vs 0.971 (x100). Best threshold scanned over the 1st-99th percentile of scores.

benchmarks.name: SSF held-out skill matching accuracy @ cosine 0.5
benchmarks.config: Same table, Acc @ 0.5: 0.810 baseline vs 0.968 (x100) - the untuned threshold now works, which is the operationally relevant row.
